inventory_meta.sha_note: meta_sha256 is the embedded provenance sha, assembled during inventory build on WSL and not reconstructible from the file. raw_file_sha256 is the current on-disk sha256 of exp77_inventory.json. doc 67 §6 registered prefix a9e9de9ead17cfee matches meta_sha256. Both hashes pin file identity; raw_file_sha256 would catch future edits to the words array that leave meta intact.

config.FLAG_readout: computational-basis collision readout: P(same_root) = sigmoid(a * dot(probs_A, probs_B) + b). probs_X = |U(theta) @ encoded_X|^2 as 2^3-dim prob vector. Trainable: U(theta) sits inside probs; collision changes with theta. Reusable verbatim by the wazn-ansatz arm.
config.FLAG_featurizer: per-slot positional extraction, doc 65 lineage adapted for multi-slot. Column->slot indices: faail[0,2,3], faiil[0,1,3], fa33aal[0,1,3], maf3uul[1,2,4], mu1[1,2,3], mu2[1,2,3]. Char->angle: pi*(cp-0x0621)/40 in [0,pi]; out-of-range -> pi/2. Slot clamp fallback: min(s, len(bare)-1). Column as Rz(2*pi*col_idx/6) on all 3 wires (data, not structure). Root field NEVER an input: keys are (surface, column) only.

split.negative_protocol: doc 66 §11.2: different-root cross-template pairs with |letter_set(A) & letter_set(B)| >= 3 after stripping ال. Ratio 1:1 with positives per split. Sampling: at least one word has root in the split's anchor-roots set; second word drawn from full inventory. Featurizer is fixed (no learned embeddings) so cross-split words in negatives cause no information leakage.
split.FLAG_negative_deviation: Pilot only. Within-split sampling (doc 66 §11.3's intent) was infeasible at 1:1: test pool produced 139 candidates, 152 needed. Resolution: anchor-words from test-roots + full inventory for second word. This is acceptable here (no learned word parameters). The main run CANNOT inherit this: §11.3's factorial holdout forbids test-root words appearing in train negatives. Main run must either (a) sample strictly within-split and subsample positives to match (recommended), or (b) restate the deviation explicitly in its freeze. Bar-freeze must decide this before wazn-ansatz code runs.
split.epoch_selection: best val acc across all 150 epochs
